summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new PAUSE requests: (1) Topic grid icons shrunk ~15% and no reflection/light-bar effects under tiles (no `category-light-*` / `category-selected-*` inside `category-grid`), and (2) Shareable story card bottom-sheet on the deep-dive ending. Both passed end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844 via Expo web preview. Deprecated style/prop warnings only (`textShadow*`, `props.pointerEvents`) — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated `textShadow*` style props used; migrate to the single `textShadow` shorthand. Observed in console warnings on topic/profile screens; search for `textShadow` in theme/typography/components.

`pointerEvents` passed as a prop on `View`/`Animated.View` is deprecated — move to `style.pointerEvents`. Many instances across components (e.g. /app/frontend/src/components/category-grid.tsx line 94, 128; /app/frontend/src/components/story-share-card.tsx line 36, 67; /app/frontend/src/components/reader-ending.tsx lines 137,140,146,182,184; /app/frontend/src/components/category-tile-effects.tsx line 19,33,57).

action_items: Address React Native deprecation warnings: replace `pointerEvents` prop usage with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` and consolidate `textShadowColor/Offset/Radius` into the newer `textShadow` shorthand (web-compat still OK) to future-proof.
No functional issues found — both the topic-icon shrink/remove-reflection and the Instagram-style share card bottom sheet work on web.
critical_code_review_comments: `CategorySelectionLight` is still used by `home-controls.tsx` (home deck) — kept the light bar outside the picker as requested. The user's request mentioned the topic *picker* so this is intentional; confirm with user if the home deck's selection bar should also be removed.

`StoryShareSheet.onShare` swallows errors silently with `catch {}`; on web non-fatal failures (e.g., user dismiss) are fine, but adding a toast or at minimum `console.warn` would help diagnose future failures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest onboarding path: fill `onboarding-profile-name`, click `onboarding-profile-continue` (step 1), wait for `category-grid`, click `chip-all` (or any `chip-<id>`), click `onboarding-continue` to land on `home-screen`. First deck card testID is dynamic (`home-story-<slug>-open`); pick via regex `^home-story-.*-open$`. On deep-dive page, scroll ~15 wheel ticks of 2000px to reveal `share-story` button in `deep-dive-ending`. Share sheet IDs: share-sheet, share-sheet-backdrop, share-sheet-close, share-sheet-confirm, share-preview, share-format-story, share-format-post, story-share-card-story / story-share-card-post. On web, confirm share triggers navigator.share text fallback — stays on deep-dive, no crash.
rca_of_issue: N/A — verification only.
